act_title: The Bihar Value Added Tax Act, 2005
title: Cartons (including flattened or folded cartons), boxes (including flattened or folded boxes),
text:
146. Cartons (including flattened or folded cartons), boxes (including flattened or folded boxes),
cases, bags and other packing containers, of paper, paperboard, whether in assembled or
unassembled condition.
